id: Unique id representing a release, compiled_release or record
document_index: Position of the document in the documents array
release_type: Either release, record, compiled_release or embedded_release. With "release", individual releases are read through the release table. With "record", a compiled release is read from a record's compiledRelease field through the record table. With "compiled_release", a compiled release is read through the compiled_release table, which is calculated by Kingfisher Process (for example, by merging a collection of releases). With "embedded_releases", individual releases are read from a record's releases array through the record table.
release_id: Release id from the data. Relevant for releases and not for compiled_releases or records
data_id: id for the "data" table in Kingfisher that holds the original JSON data.
field_list: All JSON paths in the document object, excluding array indices, expressed as a JSONB object in which keys are paths and values are NULL. This column is only available if the --field-lists option was used.
